name: Mission San Carlos Borromeo
aka: Mission San Carlos Borromeo de Carmelo
Mission San Carlos Borromeo del Río Carmelo

aliases: Rio Road & Lausen Drive, Carmel-by-the-Sea, Monterey County, California

dates.note: The National Park Service says 'In 1793, Father Lausen, Father Serra's successor, supervised the construction of a more permanent stone church'; the California Missions Foundation says 'It took Father Lasuén fourteen years to fulfill Father Serra's dream – the new church was completed in 1797'; Architectural Resources Group gives 'The church, built in 1797'. The mission itself was founded 1770 in Monterey and moved to Carmel in 1771.
